signatureEffect: Tilt-shift miniature focus band that keeps the toy fort crisp over a real sea horizon, through six times of one seaside day.

direction.fantasy: A painted wooden toy siege on a chalk sea-stack island, seen through a tilt-shift lens from dawn to a lantern-lit night.

references.source: photographic technique: tilt-shift miniature photographs of harbours and coastal villages shot from a cliff top
references.why: A narrow sharp band across the subject with a soft foreground and a soft sea horizon is what makes a real place read as a table-top model

references.source: craft reference: hand-painted wooden toy castles, peg figures and building blocks with rounded edges and visible brush strokes
references.why: Matte painted wood, chalky stone, clear glass, pale ice and glossy black stone are the five block families the fort must read as at a glance

references.source: observational reference: one coastal day from a crisp sunrise through noon haze and sea mist to a red storm sunset and a starry harbour night
references.why: Six distinct sun, sky and fog states over one chalk-cliff island give every chapter its own time of day while the palette stays one family
